correctness.rationale: Exact integer-pair golden-field arithmetic proves 6-generator genericity, 60 exposed edges, 32 vertices, 120 Coxeter fundamental copies, all 16 vertex axes and exactly three crossing great circles. Four angular chambers exhaust the spherical triangle and their exact edge counts are 10,12,14,12. Girard/atan2 formula gives exact area fractions; an independent edge-crossing sum matches the mean to 65 digits. Finite Monte Carlo is auxiliary.
